name: Riddle Garden
source:
"Everything in my world is here."

Bordered by grand walls was a chalk-white castle that stood in the middle of a vast garden. A stream flowed within the forest that surrounded the castle and an old water mill stood there. A girl named Colette lived in that castle and wanted for nothing. Besides Colette, the only others that resided there were her pet rabbit Mashiro, her butler Elick, her governess Claire and some other servants. 

Ever since she could remember, Colette didn't have a single family member. She had absolutely no idea why she was in a castle, what her social status was and who she exactly was.

One stormy night, five men visited the castle. All of them claimed that they were invited to the castle to be "selected by Colette".

While bewildered, Colette then received a letter. That letter said that one of the invited guests was no longer able to come due to being attacked by ruffians.

It was certain that exactly five guests were invited.
Yet, somehow, there were five guests here despite what the letter said.

"It seems that an uninvited guest has made their way inside."

[Translated from [url=http://calamelia.clearrave.co.jp/product/riddle/story.html]The Official website[/url]]
translation:
「我的整個世界都在這裡。」

宏偉高牆環繞著一座純白城堡，城堡矗立在廣闊花園中央。周圍森林中溪水流淌，岸邊還立著一座古老水車。名叫柯蕾特的女孩住在城堡裡，生活上什麼也不缺。除了柯蕾特，這裡只有她的寵物兔真白、管家艾利克、家庭教師克萊爾和幾名傭人。

從記事起，柯蕾特便沒有任何家人。她完全不知道自己為何身處城堡、擁有怎樣的社會地位，也不知道自己究竟是誰。

一個暴風雨之夜，五名男子來到城堡。他們都聲稱自己受邀前來，接受「柯蕾特的選擇」。

正當柯蕾特困惑不已時，她收到一封信。信中說，一名受邀來賓遭暴徒襲擊，已經無法赴約。

可以確定，受邀者恰好是五人。
然而，信裡明明說有一人無法赴約，城堡裡卻依舊出現了五名客人。

「看來，有一位不速之客混了進來。」

[翻譯自[url=http://calamelia.clearrave.co.jp/product/riddle/story.html]官方網站[/url]]
